estimates.indicative.persistenceClasses: classes on a saved-data-shaped path; the same limit applies
estimates.side.layout: read off whether the archive carries assets, data, or both; no mod declares a side

reads: first four bytes of each archive entry, to tell an archive from a resource
mod index entry: filename, hash, project id and file id
tables of contents of the jar-in-jar libraries an artifact ships, at any depth
the acquired artifact files, hashed and not opened

packOverlay.note: Counted, never transcribed. The pack overrides are ATM-owned, so no name from either tree is recorded here; the only thing that travels is a flag on a mod id the mod itself declared. Every capability these files provide has to be respecified from observed behaviour rather than ported.
